_comment: Copy for /legal. Company identification values come from company.json (identity, contacts) — placeholders live there, not here. The privacy notice covers ONLY what the site actually does: one enquiry form, no cookies, no analytics. If analytics are ever added, the cookies section must be updated in the same commit.

sections.title: What the enquiry form collects
sections.body: The request-a-quote form collects your company name, country, contact name, email address, and optionally a phone number, volume and timeline information, a message, and any files you attach.

sections.title: Why
sections.body: To assess your enquiry and respond to it. The data is not used for anything else — no marketing lists, no profiling, no resale.

sections.title: Confidentiality of submitted files
sections.body: Drawings and files you send are treated as confidential and are not shared outside the company.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: This site sets no tracking or advertising cookies and uses no analytics services. Fonts are served from this domain; no third-party requests are made when you view the site.

terms.heading: Terms of use
paragraphs: The content of this site is informational and does not constitute a binding offer. Specifications, figures and capabilities described here are subject to confirmation in a written quotation.
Product names and drawings submitted through the enquiry form remain the property of their owners. Nothing on this site grants rights to any trademark or design shown or referenced.
